secondary_four_venue_reconstruction.interpretation: The deepest XRP print was venue-specific. Bitstamp traded substantially less XRP than Binance over the same ten-minute interval and printed a much deeper wick. This supports a local thin-book/liquidity-vacuum amplifier layered on top of the broader market shock.

market_wide_liquidations.interpretation: A real long-led market-wide deleveraging wave was underway within minutes of the observed cliff. This materially strengthens liquidation amplification, but the rolling one-hour statistic cannot identify the first initiating trade.

canada_tariff_external_event_control.description: The temporary suspension expired and additional 50% duties on specified Canadian goods took effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern on Aug. 22.
canada_tariff_external_event_control.reason: The policy transition is authoritative and economically material, but it preceded the 05:10-05:11 crypto cliff by about 69-70 minutes. Current evidence does not show a tightly timestamped 05:10 news release or cross-asset response proving this tariff event initiated the crypto shock.

important_correction: The previously discussed approximately 14% XRP app decline should not be interpreted as a uniform cross-venue XRP crash magnitude. New venue-level evidence shows the most extreme 37% wick was Bitstamp-specific, while major venues printed materially higher lows. XRP still experienced an outsized broad decline relative to BTC/ETH controls, but venue liquidity materially amplified the visible tail.
